source.name: EKOI — XDS-ASTANA Replica Jersey EKOI Racing Proteam (official team replica)
source.quote: The UCI WorldTour Team XDS ASTANA Replica Jersey
source.note: The official replica of the 2026 race jersey carries SHIMANO on the upper chest (with the UCI WorldTeam badge); placements verified from the product photos, which match DirectVelo's photo of the race kit.

source.name: DirectVelo — XDS Astana : Le maillot 2026 (Nicolas Gachet)
source.quote: Le nouveau maillot est quasi-identique mais il est désormais réalisé par la société Ekoï et non plus Biemme.
source.note: EKOI became the team's official supplier of clothing and eyewear from 2026 (three-year deal); EKOI's own replica page (https://www.ekoi.com/en-us/short-sleeve-cycling-jerseys/18412-replica-jersey-ekoi-racing-proteam-xds-astana.html) shows the EKOI mark on the chest and back of the jersey.

summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam. XDS title sponsor across the front of the EKOI-made jersey, Samruk-Kazyna on the shoulders and back, Shimano on the chest, SportQory on the back pockets.
